Lina (Capacity): Heads-up: we9re putting G720 micro-pools into a controlled soft-launch next week. Regions: SIN-2 (ap-southeast-1) and MAD-1 (eu-south-1). Details below.
DeployBot: Maintenance window scheduled: 2026-05-03 01:00 UTC 1:00-03:00 UTC for setup and kernel preload.
Lina (Capacity): What to expect: G720 = high memory bandwidth + tensor accel for medium-long context workloads. Typical uplift vs A10g is ~1.4x for decoder workloads; expect better throughput on batched rerank jobs.
Jorge R: Any difference in reservation granularity?
Lina (Capacity): Yes 1 GPU granularity supported for micro-pools. You can reserve as small as 1 GPU for up to 30 days. Burst windows available for short-term scaling.
Maya (Product): Pricing/quotas?
Lina (Capacity): Intro trial price: $0.85/hr per GPU for burst and $1.25/hr for reserved commits (trial only). Quotas will be auto-increased for beta participants. No change to SLA during beta; production SLA TBD after performance validation.
SE Concierge: Migration note for teams on RTX pools 1: update routing to include `g720-compatible` label or explicit fallback to rtx7000/rtx6000.
Infra Oncall: Important: NVSwitch firmware versions older than 5.2 may show higher error counts. We9re applying a forced firmware patch during the window; if you see `nvswitch-fw` logs, escalate immediately.
Lina (Capacity): Burst windows (UTC):
 - SIN-2: Sun/Mon 00:00-04:00 UTC, Wed 12:00-16:00 UTC
 - MAD-1: Tue/Thu 02:00-06:00 UTC, Sat 18:00-22:00 UTC
 - Minimum burst unit: 2 GPUs, max per-customer burst: 24 GPUs
Jorge R: Any runtime flags to recommend?
Lina (Capacity): Recommend `--exec-mode tensor_fast`, `--kv-cache=on`, `--max-seq=2048`. Set `max_batch_size=24` for highest p99 stability. Example CLI for early access: 
```
redwoodctl reservations create --region ap-southeast-1 --pool g720-sin-2 --gpus 4 --term 168h --tags "g720-beta"
```
Maya (Product): We9ll add a small FAQ and a marketing banner for customers in those regions. Please provide a short blurb for the public docs.
Lina (Capacity): Blurb: "G720 micro-pools: lower-cost dedicated options for medium-length inference and batch reranking. Beta pricing and limited windows apply. Sign up for early access via Support."
Infra Oncall: Oncall checklist: monitor `egress-bw` and `model-crash` metrics. If you see >2x baseline egress or `oom-model` traces, flip routing to fallback pools.
SE Concierge: We9ll coordinate 1:1 sessions for 5 top customers to test perf profiles.
Lina (Capacity): Action items: @eng-runtime validate kernels for top 10 models by Wed EOD. @support prepare support email template. @sales flag prospects in MAD/SIN for outreach. React with :white_check_mark: when you9re assigned. Keeping thread locked to updates during the beta.
